notes.title: Here we come!
notes.content:
Welcome everyone~
We are about to release an early access version of Idle Animal Plaza on October 14th!

[previewyoutube=U7CRnzJ3SsQ;full][/previewyoutube]

At present, the first chapter of the game, Island Plaza, has been completed. The game has rich content and gameplay:
● 6 different types of restaurants, each with 8 different themes
● Design more than 10 customers and 6 special store managers
● There is a task system and a variety of special events
● In addition to restaurant management, there are 3 mini-game modes for fun
Our game is mainly casual, providing food production processes and light simulation management experience for various restaurants. We will continue to optimize according to the feedback of players after the launch, and continue to expand subsequent chapters.
